text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about with Hishi 
Akebono...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Wahaa~~♪ Look at this super cute plushie!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Umm, let's see... it says 'Paka Petit'!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking where Hishi Akebono pointed, there 
was a crane game filled with plushies 
modeled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"If we collect a lot, it'll feel lively, 
like we're surrounded by everyone♪"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Sleeping together when it's cold, chatting 
when we're bored... That's bono, isn't it? 
☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I'm really bad at crane games, though.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I always aim for the giant prizes, so I've 
never actually managed to win anything...
choice_data_list: Let me get it for you instead!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, really!? That's super buono! I'll be 
cheering for you, Trainer!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
